text:
maria: Heads-up — a customer flagged that the console audit CSV export is missing actor.email on ~2% of rows for large exports (>50k). They attached a file where many rows have blank actor_email but non-empty actor_id. Otel shows some 'decrypt failed: truncated' errors around the same intervals. Anyone seen this pattern?
aj: Do we have a sample row or the exact error? Is this only affecting CSV or JSON exports too?
maria: Pasted sample from their CSV: 
```
2026-03-22T18:02:11Z,actor:user_123,,model.request,OK
2026-03-22T18:02:12Z,actor:user_124,user124@example.com,model.request,OK
```
Note the blank third field. The syslog shows: `kms: decrypt failed: truncated blob` for several events during a window.
kevin: We rolled an RBAC change last week that masks certain fields for the 'audit-viewer' role unless the 'export_sensitive' permission bit is present. Could be a policy mis-eval where export flow drops the permission on large streaming exports. Commit ref: `a7c9d2f` touched exporter auth path.
tanvi: Another angle — we rotated the KMS key two days ago and kicked off a rewrap job. Looks like shard-7 rewraps are still pending; rewrap worker logs show timeouts. If a blob is still wrapped with the old key and we try direct decrypt with the new key, we get truncated/decrypt errors.
aj: So two simultaneous failure modes: RBAC mask logic + KMS rewrap gaps. Which one explains missing emails (not masked text like '***')? Masking would replace with `[redacted]` or empty depending on exporter; decrypt errors could yield empty fields.
maria: Customer says JSON export contained the email in most cases but some objects had `actor.encrypted_meta` as base64 instead of plain fields. So JSON sometimes preserves the encrypted blob when exporter can't decrypt, CSV drops it.
kevin: Sounds like exporter CSV path doesn't handle encrypted payload fallback correctly. JSON exporter passes through leftover encrypted_meta; CSV does naive field extraction and emits blank. We'll need a small schema-aware fix: if `actor.encrypted_meta` present and decrypt fails, emit a placeholder like `<encrypted:decrypt-failed>` and include a footer note.
tanvi: Agreed. From vuln/triage POV this isn't data exfil but it is integrity/visibility — could cause billing/audit disputes. I'll open an incident if we classify it as customer-impacting.
security-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0423 (created by tanvi).
maria: Customer also asked for a preview in Console. Console preview currently caches first 100 rows and uses streaming CSV conversion; preview shows blanks which looks worse. Can we make preview surface a reason string so users see 'failed to decrypt (key rotation in progress)' versus silent blank?
aj: Good UX call. Plan: 1) Patch exporter CSV to annotate failed decrypts with a token. 2) Add console preview explanatory tooltip + link to rewrap job status. 3) Fix RBAC evaluation so 'export_sensitive' is respected during streaming exports. 4) Backfill rewrap for shard-7.
kevin: I'll take RBAC export path. Quick hotfix: ensure auth check in exporter uses request-scoped permission set rather than cached role bits. PR incoming: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/9876 (draft).
tanvi: I'll own KMS rewrap urgency and backfill. Running `psql -c "select id,status,shard from rewrap_jobs where status != 'done'"` now and will restart workers on shard-7. Backfill ETA: overnight, hotfix to export in 4 hours so previews and CSVs show placeholders instead of blanks.
maria: Can you also add a regression test that simulates key-rotation + partial rewrap? We saw this surface only on exports >50k rows due to streaming windowing.
kevin: Yep — adding a sampling test for >50k rows and a CI matrix that toggles 'wrap_state: partial' to catch the CSV path.
aj: I'll draft a short customer response: "Thanks — we've identified a gap where partial KMS rewraps plus exporter CSV logic can produce empty actor fields. We're deploying a hotfix that will mark failed decrypts as '<encrypted:decrypt-failed>' in CSV and add a preview explanation. Full backfill is running; we'll deliver the corrected export by EOD." maria, ok to send?
maria: Sending now.
kevin: After hotfix I'll add a schema migration note to the audit docs — new column `actor.encrypted_meta` and exporter behavior during decryption failures. Also add export checksum to help customers detect row drops during download.
tanvi: Filed follow-ups: INC-2026-0423, TASK-4582 (backfill shard-7), PR-9876 (RBAC fix), PR-9877 (CSV decrypt placeholder + preview UX).
maria: Thanks all. Keep this thread updated and tag me on PR merges. I'll close once customer confirms and we backfill. :thumbsup:
